smoke.interpretation: Integration/early learning only; insufficient for strength claims.

standard.interpretation: Eight-opponent development suite, equal map/opponent weights, both seats. Improvement against fixed cp2 baseline.

evaluation_protocol.selection: Freeze map and seed schedules across checkpoints; reserve an additional unseen-map suite for final claims. If evaluation maps are used for self-play, label these results in-distribution.
metrics: equal-weight mean over represented panel opponents with coverage shown
paired-map-seed bootstrap 95% interval for complete shared cells; descriptive per-opponent Wilson intervals
ending reason, rounds and terminal game points
crashes/timeouts/illegal actions recorded separately from completed games
evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: Do not silently drop failures or count them as ordinary game losses. Publish completion rate and failure counts; report win rate on completed games with explicit denominator. A match forfeited under engine rules remains a game result, labelled forfeiture.
evaluation_protocol.compute_mode: Evaluate candidate and benchmarks under the same documented local engine settings. Record engine binary hash and patches; bytecode relaxation changes historical baselines.
